entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/checkout
entities.reasoning: A pod of the checkout deployment was in CrashLoopBackOff, triggering a critical alert and preventing the service from handling requests.
entities.evidence: CrashLoopBackOffPodsDetected alert (1 pod) and pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9cgqs showing failure in metrics.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend observed increased error rate and latency as downstream checkout failed.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate (36) and RequestLatency (25) alerts for service_name=frontend in otel-demo namespace.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend-proxy
entities.reasoning: Proxy forwarded failing requests to checkout, contributing to observed errors.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/accounting
entities.reasoning: Accounting calls checkout during order processing; checkout failure caused error spikes.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/shipping
entities.reasoning: Shipping service depends on checkout to retrieve order details; errors propagated.

propagations.condition: checkout pods failed (CrashLoopBackOff) and did not respond
propagations.effect: frontend received error responses, raising RequestErrorRate and latency alerts

propagations.condition: proxy could not reach checkout backend
propagations.effect: proxy returned 5xx errors, contributing to RequestErrorRate alerts
accounting calls failed, increasing its error rate alerts

propagations.condition: checkout could not provide order confirmation
propagations.effect: shipping experienced errors, reflected in its RequestErrorRate alert

alerts_explained.explanation: A pod in otel-demo namespace is stuck in CrashLoopBackOff, indicating a container start failure.
Error rate of calls exceeds zero for multiple services, caused by downstream checkout failure.
95th percentile latency >1500ms for services, result of retries and timeouts after checkout went down.
High CPU throttling observed on pods, likely due to resource contention on the node hosting checkout.
Informational alerts that inhibit other alerts; not directly related to the incident.
